The '''Stennaros system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Har Worlds]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stennaros/Legends|Stennaros]].<ref name="Ss" />

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Stennaros system was introduced in the [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]] source article "[[Shape-shifters]]," written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] for [[February]] [[1997]]'s [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 12|twelfth issue]] of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine.<ref name="Ss" />

The article originally placed Stennaros and its system in the "Stennes sector."<ref name="Ss" /> However, [[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', indicated in [[June]] [[2015]] that the sector's name was omitted from [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] at the request of [[Lucasfilm]] in order to avoid confusion with the [[Stenness Node]].<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2015-06-30}}</ref> Instead, Stennaros was placed in the Har Worlds sector of the Expansion Region.<ref name="EAOC" />
